name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_shutdown
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi::Shutdown unadvises the event-sink connection point, releases the WOL API COM object, clears the global API pointer, and closes the three stored handles when the API object is present.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The event-sink IID is modeled as a typed source symbol for the observed connection-point identity; no VC COFF data-symbol evidence exists yet for the immutable GUID data.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43d280 validates the null API pointer early return, zCom::ConnectionPointContainer_Unadvise call with g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi, the event-sink connection point IID, and g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiAdviseCookie, COM Release through vtable slot 2, clearing the API pointer, and CloseHandle on g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeBootstrapServerListEvent, g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeStatusTextEvent, and g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeFailureEvent.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_shutdown_smoke verifies the null path performs no COM calls, then uses a fake IConnectionPointContainer/IConnectionPoint source to verify FindConnectionPoint, Unadvise with the stored cookie, connection point/container Release calls, source Release, and clearing g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi while closing real event handles.
